business_overview.one_sentence: The group provides inland port uploading, unloading, handling and ancillary port services in Chizhou, Anhui, PRC.

segments.name: Provision of port services
segments.source: 2024 annual report, note 6 and note 7(a), pages 118-119

business_overview.revenue_model: Port service fees from bulk cargo, break bulk cargo, container and ancillary port services; revenue is generated in the PRC.
business_notes: The annual report discloses one operating segment: provision of port services.
All 2024 and 2023 revenue was derived in the PRC; non-current assets are located or based in the PRC.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Interest from cash deposits and time deposits; should not be counted as operating-business profit after stripping surplus cash.

non_recurring_items.item: Government grants and deferred grant amortisation
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Government grants include asset-related amortisation and unconditional rewards; recurring quality is weaker than port service fees.
Gains on land resumption of PPE and investment properties.

non_recurring_items.item: Change in fair value of investment properties
non_recurring_items.source: 2024 annual report, consolidated statement of comprehensive income, page 88

funds_assets.item: Cash deposits at banks and on hand
funds_assets.business_substance: Bank cash and on-hand cash; group cash is materially held in PRC operating structure and remittance of RMB cash out of the PRC is subject to exchange control.
Bank short-term deposits with original maturity of 1 to 3 months.
funds_assets.source: 2024 annual report, statement of cash flows and note 21, pages 94 and 139

funds_assets.item: Time deposits classified as current assets
funds_assets.business_substance: Fixed deposits with original maturity over three months but within one year.

operating_assets.business_substance: Terminal facilities, port machinery and right-of-use assets used in the port business.
operating_assets.source: 2024 annual report, statement of financial position and MD&A, pages 89 and 10

operating_assets.business_substance: Port service receivables, generally with 10 to 55 day credit terms.

operating_assets.item: Debt instruments at FVOCI - bills receivables
operating_assets.business_substance: Bank acceptance bills from operating settlement, maturity 3 to 6 months; treated as operating working capital rather than detachable surplus cash.

investment_assets.business_substance: PRC investment properties; RMB14.1 million pledged to banking facilities; not counted as detachable cash.
investment_assets.source: 2024 annual report, note 15 and note 27, pages 131 and 143

investment_assets.business_substance: Level 3 unlisted PRC equity investments in Chizhou Wusha and Chizhou Tie Hang; not counted as detachable funds.
Unlisted associate measured by share of net assets.

other_assets.business_substance: Operating deposits, prepayments and other receivables split between non-current and current assets.
other_assets.source: 2024 annual report, statement of financial position, page 89

financing_liabilities.business_substance: The group had no outstanding bank borrowings or outstanding debts at 31 December 2024.
Office property lease liabilities; treated as ordinary operating lease burden rather than full cash-debt deduction.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Customer deposits received before port services are provided.

operating_liabilities.item: Other payables, accruals and receipt in advance
operating_liabilities.business_substance: Includes construction cost payables, fixed asset acquisition payables, accruals and tenant rental receipts in advance.

other_liabilities.business_substance: Dividend payable to non-controlling interests, unsecured, interest-free and repayable on demand.
other_liabilities.source: 2024 annual report, note 34 and note 35, pages 148 and related note

other_liabilities.business_substance: Deferred government grant liability split current and non-current.
other_liabilities.source: 2024 annual report, statement of financial position, pages 89-90

other_liabilities.item: Income tax payable and deferred tax liabilities
other_liabilities.business_substance: Current income tax payable plus deferred tax liabilities.
other_liabilities.source: 2024 annual report, statement of financial position, pages 89-90

years.source: 2023 annual report comparative columns, pages 73 and 78-79
2024 annual report comparative columns and 2023 annual report cash flow, pages 88 and 93-94
2024 annual report, consolidated statements of comprehensive income and cash flows, pages 88 and 93-94

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year operating cash flow is above parent net profit, but 2024 operating cash flow fell due to contract-liability release and bills receivable growth. Port assets require ongoing maintenance capex. A conservative owner-earnback denominator uses normalized parent profit adjusted down for interest income, non-recurring gains and required reinvestment.

evidence.source: 2024 annual report, statement of financial position and note 21, pages 89 and 139

evidence.value: RMB-denominated cash and bank balances approximately RMB172.650 million; remittance out of PRC subject to exchange control restrictions

gaps: The annual report does not split cash and deposits by legal entity, parent/subsidiary level or exact offshore/onshore location.
No explicit restricted cash line was found; property pledges secure unused banking facilities, but no cash pledge was disclosed.
Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; PPE additions are used as a conservative proxy.
